attributes.abstract: Direct SARS-CoV-2 infection in left ventricle was not observed, suggesting that cardiac complications are indirectly related to SARS-CoV-2 infection. A cardioprotective role for vitamin D as a possible therapeutic remains inconclusive.

attributes.title: Develop Your Mentoring Team: A New Look at Building Strategic Relationships to Maximize Success in Graduate School and Beyond
attributes.name: ABRCMS 2022
attributes.organization: ANNUAL BIOMEDICAL RESEARCH CONFERENCE FOR MINORITIZED SCIENTISTS
attributes.abstract: The essential premise of the session was that successful career navigation requires strategic relationship formation with multiple groups of individuals to ensure professional and personal success.
attributes.comment: We explored the role of the PI as mentor and establishing healthy interactions, and also other persons inside and outside academia, including peer mentors, to successfully navigate various stress points in the life of a graduate student. The session was also appealing to undergraduate and post bac students. Both didactic and case study approaches (examples of problems, stresses, conflicts and resolution) were employed, providing a road map for students to implement, and form success circles to help navigate issues which may arise.
